tool_args.rationale: The paid observations exhibit the archived mechanism's predicted positive short-horizon gain and negative long-horizon reversal. Fit all four parameters numerically and test the resulting law on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The slow-horizon probe already supplies eight observations spanning the short response and reversal, sufficient to fit and confirm the four-parameter candidate.
These do not explain both the positive short-horizon response and the observed negative long-horizon response as directly as the archived dual-horizon mechanism.
It is a less direct explanation of the observed reversal; fresh confirmation can test the specific archived dual-horizon law first.
